newsitem.title: USA: CIGNA unit buys flood insurer.
newsitem.headline: CIGNA unit buys flood insurer.

text.p: CIGNA Corp's CIGNA Property & Casualty said on Tuesday it acquired Amerimax Flood Certification, a Los Angeles-based provider of flood hazard information services, for undisclosed terms.

Martin Gentleman, president of CIGNA Financial Institution Services, said the acquisition would let CIGNA Property & Casualty offer mortgage lenders a comprehensive, integrated flood insurance and compliance program.
CIGNA FIS acquired Amerimax's assets and business through its CIGNA Flood Services Inc subsidiary, the company said.
Gentleman said the Amerimax staff and management team, including Chief Executive Officer Chris Glenn and President Kevin Leonard, would continue with the new CIGNA FIS/Amerimax organization.
